results.snippet: A printing press is a machine by which text and images are transferred from movable type to paper or other media by means of ink. Movable type and paper were first developed in China, and printing first became mechanized in Europe during the 15th century.

results.title: Printing Press - Invented, Gutenberg, Significance | HISTORY
results.snippet: May 7, 2018 · Created in China, the printing press revolutionized society there before being further developed in Europe in the 15th Century by Johannes Gutenberg and his invention of the Gutenberg press.
